snippet.description:

Turn a tiny mining ship into a planet-shredding powerhouse. Dig through bountiful layers, build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your drone friends join the fun. Experience this satisfying adventure full of sparkling treasure, adorable wildlife, and buried wonders.
